reference_policy.rule: Use the most specific applicable reference. Never replace a known manufacturer/model target with a generic fallback.
reference_policy.missing: If no defensible reference applies, leave the parameter unclassified rather than inventing a threshold.

evaporatorSuperheat.basis: General educational screening interval, not a manufacturer charging or performance specification. Replace with equipment-specific reference when available.

condenserSubcooling.basis: General educational screening interval, not a manufacturer charging or performance specification. Replace with equipment-specific reference when available.

diagnostic_architecture.measurement_layer: preserve value; classify only against applicable reference
diagnostic_architecture.next_check_policy: select unresolved check by discrimination value, using manufacturer-curated check order as tie-break/context
